name: anyrun
label: ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox
description:
ANY.RUN empowers SOC teams to cut MTTD/MTTR with fast verdicts using the Interactive Sandbox. With the ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox connector for FortiSOAR, your team achieves:
- Faster triage: Submit files/URLs for instant analysis across Windows, Linux, Android. Get answers in seconds to catch threats that beat standard defenses and increase the detection rate by up to 36%.
- Streamlined workflows: Retrieve reports (JSON, HTML, IOCs) directly in FortiSOAR without tool-switching. Act without delays to stop attacks before they have a chance to hurt your infrastructure.

operations.title: Retrieve Analysis Verdict
operations.description: Retrieve the verdict and current status of an analysis from ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox using the specified Analysis ID.

parameters.title: Analysis ID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the analysis task in ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox.
parameters.name: task_uuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the analysis task in ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox.

operations.title: Retrieve Analysis Report
operations.description: Retrieve an analysis report from ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox using the specified Analysis ID. The Analysis ID is generated when a new analysis is submitted.

parameters.title: Analysis ID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the task whose report you want to retrieve from ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox.
parameters.name: task_uuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the task whose report you want to retrieve from ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox. A Task ID is generated from an analysis submitted to ANY.RUN.

parameters.title: Report Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Select a report type to retrieve. You can select one of the following: Json, IOC, STIX, MISP, or HTML. Default value is Json.
parameters.name: report_type
parameters.tooltip: Select a report type to retrieve. You can select one of the following: Json, IOC, STIX, MISP, or HTML. Default value is Json.

operations.title: Retrieve Report Attachments
operations.description: Retrieve the analysis report from ANY.RUN Cloud Sandbox as an attachment in JSON or HTML format using the specified Analysis ID.

parameters.title: Analysis ID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the task whose report attachments such as the HTML report, screenshot, execution video, MISP record, etc. you want to retrieve from ANY.RUN.
parameters.name: task_uuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the task whose report attachments such as the HTML report, screenshot, execution video, MISP record, etc. you want to retrieve from ANY.RUN. Task ID is generated from an analysis submitted to ANY.RUN. etc.

parameters.title: Report Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Select a report type to retrieve. You can select one of the following: Json, IOC, STIX, MISP, or HTML. Default value is Json.
parameters.name: report_type
parameters.tooltip: Select a report type to retrieve. You can select one of the following: Json, IOC, STIX, MISP, or HTML. Default value is Json.
